_about: Courses missing from OpenStreetMap, added by hand. tools/fetch_discgolf.py merges these in on every refresh and drops one automatically once OSM has a course with the same name within 1.5 km. Each needs a source. Better still: add the course to openstreetmap.org, then delete it here.

courses.name: Tjader Acres Disc Golf Course

info.charge: $5 suggested all-day donation; kids 16 and under free
info.description: 27 wooded, hilly holes in three 9-hole loops (A, B, C) with 9 layouts; about 3.2 miles of fairways, plan 3 to 3.5 hours. Concrete tees, Prodigy T1 baskets. Pay by cash drop box at hole 1 by the cabin, or Venmo. No garbage cans (bears): pack it out. No drinking water on the course. Open during deer season: wear blaze orange (loaner hats on the cabin porch). Restrooms at the parking lot and hole C.

courses.located: at the course address (8687 State Road 70); the first tee and parking aren't mapped yet

courses.name: Tjiny Acres (putter course)

info.charge: Same pay-what-you-play setup as Tjader Acres
info.description: 18-hole putter course opened in 2023 next to Tjader Acres: all par 3s, 91 to 138 ft (about 100 ft average), flag-marked tees, Mach III baskets. About a mile of very hilly ground; not cart- or stroller-friendly. 30 to 60 minutes. Putters only.

courses.located: next to Tjader Acres; exact spot not mapped yet
